usage: Use 藍色 to talk about the colour blue, like in clothes, objects, or things you see every day. 例：我鍾意呢件藍色衫。
藍色 can be used before a noun to describe it. 例：佢買咗一部藍色單車。
You can use 藍色 when comparing colours or choosing between options. 例：你要藍色定紅色？
藍色 is a very common everyday word, and it works in both casual speech and simple descriptions. 例：天空今日好藍。
